semanticEquivalence.policy: Full initial task plus complete task and accumulated event snapshots after each audit. Only genuinely newly appended plan UUID values mapped by append order. No field/key/array sorting/removal; dictionary comparison ignores object key order only.

limits: Three samples/version; no OS-wide exclusivity or multi-machine guarantee.
Same static snapshot through three audits, not live recapture or a complete resumed task.
Material parse, import, oracle, JSON-byte accounting and full semantic snapshot serialization occur outside phase clocks.
Peak RSS includes 327 MB material and full semantic snapshots, not production footprint.
The real fixed input has no nonempty unknown action or route flag; all original status/attempt/debt fields are preserved and fully compared.
